description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans serialization, specifically testing version tolerance features such as adding/removing fields and schema evolution. It defines test classes, custom serializers, and data models used in serialization tests.

classes.name: ObjectWithNewField
classes.description: Data model with a field that was added later, used to test version tolerance in serialization.

classes.name: ObjectWithoutNewField
classes.description: Data model without the new field, used to test deserialization of older binary data.

classes.name: BaseType
classes.description: Base class for serialization with hand-rolled serializer, representing common fields.

classes.name: SubType
classes.description: Derived class with additional fields, with custom serializer for testing.

classes.name: ObjectWithNewFieldTypeSerializer
classes.description: Custom serializer that does not serialize the new field, simulating older version serialization.

classes.name: ObjectWithoutNewFieldTypeSerializer
classes.description: Custom serializer that serializes a new field, simulating newer version serialization.

classes.name: BaseTypeSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for BaseType, hand-rolled, serializes core fields.

classes.name: SubTypeSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for SubType, handles serialization/deserialization of derived class fields.

methods.name: VersionTolerance_RoundTrip_Tests
methods.description: Main test method that performs round-trip serialization/deserialization tests with various SubType instances.

methods.name: GetSession
methods.description: Retrieves a serialization session from the session pool.

methods.name: RoundTripTest
methods.description: Performs serialization and deserialization of a SubType instance, asserting correctness and version tolerance.

methods.name: TestSkip
methods.description: Tests skipping unknown fields during deserialization.

methods.name: GetReadReferenceTable
methods.description: Builds a string representation of the read reference table for debugging.

methods.name: GetWriteReferenceTable
methods.description: Builds a string representation of the write reference table for debugging.

methods.name: ObjectWithNewField
methods.description: Data class with a new field added for testing version tolerance.

methods.name: ObjectWithoutNewField
methods.description: Data class without the new field, used to test deserialization of older data.

methods.name: BaseType
methods.description: Base class with hand-rolled serializer, representing common serialization fields.

methods.name: SubType
methods.description: Derived class with additional fields and custom serializer for testing.

methods.name: ObjectWithNewFieldTypeSerializer
methods.description: Serializer that omits the new field to simulate older version data.

methods.name: ObjectWithoutNewFieldTypeSerializer
methods.description: Serializer that includes the new field, simulating newer version data.

methods.name: SubTypeSerializer
methods.description: Serializer for SubType, handles custom serialization logic.
